description: This source file defines a React component 'TenantBootstrap' that manages tenant context initialization and routing logic based on session tenants. It handles fetching tenants, auto-selecting tenants if only one exists, redirecting to tenant selection, and navigating to dashboard views based on tenant status.

methods.name: TenantBootstrap
methods.description: React component that executes tenant bootstrap logic when mounted, handling redirects based on tenant session state.
